notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Sakashima's Student do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Sakashima's Student.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Sakashima's Student.
Activate Sakashima's Student by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
